title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Fee Dispute and Fee Credit Windows by Tier
content:
**What are the two windows?** Each tier of the Contingency Placement Agreements sets a fee dispute window and a fee credit window:

- the **fee dispute window** is the calendar days after an invoice date within which the client may dispute a fee line;
- the **fee credit window** is the calendar days after a collection is reversed within which the fee on it is credited.

| Tier | Fee dispute window (calendar days after invoice date) | Fee credit window (calendar days after the reversal) |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 30 | 90 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 30 | 90 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 30 | 120 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 45 | 120 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 45 | 180 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 60 | 180 |

**Do the two windows run from the same date?** No. The dispute window runs from the invoice date; the credit window runs from the date the collection was reversed.

**Which tiers share the same windows?** The Starter and Standard Contingency Agreements share a 30-day dispute window and a 90-day credit window; the Enterprise Contingency Agreement and the Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement share a 180-day credit window but differ in the dispute window, 45 days against 60.
